method: Independent protocol sessions with observed lock waits; complete baseline including pending-claim cleanup, with and without the incremental fix

results.name: S01 ban before activation (control)
results.expected: activation refused with account_banned; no job

results.name: S02 ban during in-flight activation
results.expected: if the ban committed before the publish committed, the publish must be refused
results.observed: ban committed while publish waited: true; publish: {"id":"38ecb6e7-685b-463c-8206-2846da068192","job_id":1,"published":true}; open jobs: 1

results.name: S03 owner close vs publish (unpublished approved post)
results.expected: after the owner closes, no open job remains for the post

results.name: S04 operator close vs publish (unpublished approved post)
results.expected: operator close is final: post closed and no open job

results.name: S05 operator review vs owner close: lock order
results.expected: review and owner close both complete without database errors

results.name: S06 operator close vs owner re-activation of live post: lock order
results.expected: operator close wins without deadlock and leaves no open job

results.name: S07 owner deletion after approval queued (approval first)
results.expected: approval publishes, deletion succeeds, org stays verified (X still owns it)
results.observed:
approval: {"id":"f79f52e6-3b09-4c67-aff5-e7958aaac901","job_id":1,"published":true}; deletion: ERROR 40P01: deadlock detected
DETAIL: Process 30320 waits f; open jobs 1; org verified

results.name: S08 owner deletion first, approval queued behind it
results.expected: deletion of a post creator neither deadlocks nor blocks approval

results.name: S09 last owner deleted, approval queued (deletion first)
results.expected: last owner deleted: org suspended, no new listing for it

results.name: S10 last owner deleted after approval (approval first)
results.expected: approved-then-deleted org: suspended, its listings hidden from anonymous visitors

results.name: S11a two owners deleted concurrently, A first
results.expected: both owners deleted: org suspended exactly once, no active owner, no error
results.observed: org suspended; active owners 0; suspension audit rows 1; errors: false

results.name: S11b two owners deleted concurrently, X first
results.expected: both owners deleted: org suspended exactly once, no active owner, no error
results.observed: org suspended; active owners 0; suspension audit rows 1; errors: false
